admission: Require independent method/code GO, complete current verification, matching zero-inference native setup/card/source preflight, exact native/Codex/source/method fingerprints and unchanged original censored artifact. Exclusive one-shot closure precedes the first model invocation. Stop on incomplete actor, unknown current usage, changed inputs, provider failure or accounting limit; do not start the writer if Jev usage is unknown. No in-cohort repair/retry. Token stops are between-invocation, not hard within-turn caps; CLI turn/output-token limits are not available.
analysis_request: Explain the apparent online-sales hit and its contribution to net sales. Establish historical coverage from the source, report the approved calendar-month comparison, and separately investigate the latest month versus the prior month through the same observed day-of-month. Discover actual saved assets; publish compact, source-linked findings and a useful next check, not an invented cause. Preserve actual units, measurement windows and uncertainty. No scheduling or sending.
freshness: Use production saved-context or explicitly labeled saved-params reconstruction, force=True requests, no arbitrary SQL or dashboard-filter claim. Per-chart request bounds, exact executed-context, saved-definition and row hashes and provider cache flags survive as provenance evidence. Source capture remains null unless all inputs explicitly confirm uncached; warehouse freshness is unknown regardless. No card freshness SLA is enabled for this historical study.
acceptance: An actual analyst-produced publication, independently checked calculations and valid comparable periods/units; native receipt preserving source hash/unknown capture and unchanged reviewed policy; configured route justified by that calendar policy, not the separate matched-day diagnostic; fresh concise human message with inspectable sources, uncertainty and useful next step. Require post-run independent process and human-message review; transport completion alone is insufficient. No notification, schedule, causal diagnosis, comparative advantage or full onboarding claim.
